instruct: A middle-aged voice, neutral in gender, with a medium pitch and steady, mid-paced delivery; the timbre is rich, grounded, and resonant, carrying a measured, folkloric warmth suitable for audiobook narration.
refText: Zwölf Boxkämpfer jagen Viktor quer über den großen Sylter Deich, und sie fragte sich, was der morgige Tag bringen würde.
